description: Glorp Logistics contract: $2.10 a crate, 500 crates a month minimum, 30 days' notice to end
body:
FREIGHT AGREEMENT
Between Glorp Logistics and Zorblax Industries, from 1 July 2026

Goods: fresh moonberries, in crates
Rate: $2.10 a crate
Minimum: 500 crates a month
Delivery: 3 days door to door
Damage: Glorp pays for crates it damages
Termination: either party, on 30 days' written notice

description: Signed the Glorp Logistics freight contract for moonberries
body: Signed the freight agreement with Glorp Logistics, from today: $2.10 a crate, at least 500 crates a month, 30 days' notice to end it.
